title: Equality of Filtered Long-Code Optima
statement: Let a family of encoded regular Unique Games, a finite set of allowed predicates, a tester using only those predicates, and a semantic instance from the family be given. Let $R$ be a uniform refinement of the associated weighted long-code experiment. For natural numbers $r$ and $M$ with $r\le M$, suppose every tester predicate has arity at most $r$. Then the filtered long-code optimum defined for this instance equals the optimum of the corresponding globally filtered long-code constraint satisfaction instance.
hypotheses_covered: A family of encoded regular Unique Games
The tester uses only predicates in that set
A semantic instance of the family
A uniform refinement of the associated weighted long-code experiment
Every tester predicate has arity at most $r$
